title: Kites in the Wind
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'e-e' and 'i-e'.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling sitting on the grass, looking up at the sky.
A bright kite flying high up against a blue sky.
A gust of wind catching a kite and lifting it upward.
Close view of a kite with a long ribbon tail trailing behind it.
The kite's long tail streaming out straight behind it as it flies steadily.
A wide kite shape shown clearly against the sky.
A sudden gust catching the kite and pulling it sharply upward.
A kite drooping and falling on a still, windless day.
Five colourful kites flying together over the park.
Ned the duckling watching happily as the kites fly overhead.
